subject: Original study demo, not Claude
method: Cloud Chromium via htmlpreview.github.io serving the public immutable GitHub commit; preview service rewrites resource loading. Normal UI actions, DOM observations and actual screenshots.

checks.observation: Page rendered with expected three-column desktop composition and original seeded transcript.
Light/dark button changed root theme and actual body background to rgb(249,249,247) / rgb(11,11,11).
About opens native dialog matching :modal and focuses its acknowledgement button; Escape closes and restores focus to trigger.
Enter submitted one message, visible generation progressed to a completed prewritten reply.
Immediate Stop ended generation but focus fell to body as the button became disabled; pending-placeholder text retained a copy action.
Gallery validation preserved short input, set aria-invalid true, showed recovery text and focused the field.
Simulated failure preserved input and showed role=alert plus retry; retry restarted generation. Explicit simulation/retry triggers lost focus to body when disabled or hidden.
Observed document had no horizontal overflow at1188x761; this does not cover narrow widths or zoom.

limitations: Not file:// or offline-load validation; browser preview fetches public static resources.
Not a complete accessibility, screen-reader, native app, cross-browser or cross-platform test.
No actual IME, forced-colors, OS reduced-motion or narrow-width testing in this pass.
Phase2 changes are not covered by this baseline commit report.
findings_status: Reported to demo author; fixes under development and require browser retest.
